messages:
sarah_p: Hey team — quick design review request. I pushed an updated Figma for the Usage & Billing page: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/usage-billing-v4 (see 'Scope Flow' frame). Main question: should the primary landing show org-level sparkline + ledger, or a project-first card grid?

maria_design: I leaned org-first because customers onboarding expect a single monthly view. org sparkline at top + project cards below. keeps mental model simple.

aj_eng: org-first makes sense for latency of queries too (one aggregation). but project cards help power users jump to filters. Can we do a hybrid?

sarah_p: hybrid idea: show org sparkline + top 3 projects as inline cards. 'View all projects' opens project grid. Thoughts on copy for that CTA?

devon_finance: Call to action should be explicit about scope: 'View all projects (project-level billing)' or 'Explore project breakouts'. Prefer the first for clarity on invoices.

maria_design: agree on clarity. also prototyping a compact token-breakdown pill that expands to a per-route ledger. current mock shows a 3-line pill: tokens | compute | discounts. expand opens accordion.

kevin_ml: curious about the token breakdown accordion UX — will it be calculated client-side? large orgs will have many routes. we should avoid pulling full route lists by default.
aj_eng: propose lazy-load route details on expand and cache per-session. backend supports pagination.

olga_accessibility: a11y note: make sure the expand/collapse has aria-expanded and an accessible label like 'Expand token breakdown for scope'. Contrast for the pill text is low on dark theme (WCAG AA fail).
maria_design: good catch. will bump text weight and adjust color. also will add focus outline to the pill.

sarah_p: invoice placement debate: do we keep 'Download invoice' in the top header (org-level) and also per-project in the project details? devon, how do customers expect this?
devon_finance: Most orgs expect a single invoice per billing account (org-level). Projects shouldn't be able to download invoices separately unless they're billed separately. Suggest greyed CTA in project view that links to org invoice with context.

maria_design: mock updated: project card now shows 'Estimated spend' and a subtle 'See invoice (org billing)' link. Also added a small sparkline hover to show last 7 days.

aj_eng: tiny implementation nit — hover sparkline SVG needs to be <svg aria-hidden=\"true\"> and we should expose data via an accessible table for screen readers.

olga_accessibility: yes please. Also keyboard users need to toggle project preview with Enter/Space; make sure affordance is clear.

kevin_ml: on the metrics side: we can include median latency per-model call in the hover panel too (useful for cost-performance tradeoffs). but it's another data call. recommend delaying unless product wants it.

sarah_p: ok action items: 1) Maria: update contrast + focus + CTA copy (due EOD). 2) Aj: lazy-load plan for token accordion and accessible table fallback (PR next week). 3) Devon: confirm invoice language for external docs. 4) Kevin: estimate cost for adding median latency data (low/med/high). 5) Olga: quick a11y smoke test when mocks updated.

pm-bot: Reminder: design-review scheduled today 16:00 UTC — agenda updated in calendar. :calendar:

sarah_p: Thanks all — dropping a link to the updated figma after changes: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/usage-billing-v4?node-id=412%3A0
maria_design: will ping when ready for re-review :white_check_mark:

aj_eng: quick question — do we need a toggle for 'Show token breakdown as percentage vs absolute tokens'? some customers asked for % view in support threads.
sarah_p: good point. add that as a micro-interaction in the accordion (locale switcher style). include in dev estimates.

devon_finance: minor copy nit: change 'Estimated spend' to 'Estimated charges' — more accounting-friendly.
maria_design: noted. switching now.

kevin_ml: small thought: when caching prefix/KV we can tag spikes per-project to show anomalous token usage — could be a future product flag. filing a ticket.
sarah_p: perfect. final: try to keep initial landing under 3 vertical scrolls for desktop. If any layout ideas break that, call it out in comments.

olga_accessibility: will also run color-blindness quick checks once the contrast update lands.

sarah_p: awesome — thanks everyone. closing thread for now unless blockers appear.
